sql: SELECT source_code,system_code,schema_name,table_name,column_name,code,meaning,status,conflict_status,current_version_id,updated_at FROM asset.asset_column_value_domains WHERE source_code='his_source_<his_host_id>' AND ((schema_name='DRUG_USER' AND table_name='MED_TRACE_RECORD' AND column_name IN ('IN_OUT_TYPE','IS_DELETED','SPLIT_FLAG','TRACES_SUM')) OR (schema_name='PHARMACY' AND table_name='DRUG_PRESC_MASTER' AND column_name IN ('PRESC_SOURCE','FLAG'))) ORDER BY schema_name,table_name,column_name,code LIMIT 100
